SLE with multiple joint pains\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003Eb)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EWhat is the etiology of the current problem and how would you as a member of the treating team arrive at a diagnosis?\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPlease chart out the sequence of events timeline between the manifestations of each of her problems and current outcomes.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: normal; text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003EAccording to the patient history,\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: normal; text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003Ethe etiology\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Emycobacterium tuberculosis\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E,also the CBNAAT done for csf is\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Epositive\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E,indicating\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ETubercular meningitis\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003ETo arrive at a diagnosis,for chronic headache CT or MRI is the preferred modality,\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003EMRI was done and it revealed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Efocal acute infarcts\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;in the left thalamus.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003EAlso lumbar puncture was done it revealed normal protein and cell count but the glucose levels were decreased.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Esequence of events\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: rgb(51, 51, 51);\"\u003ETubercular meningitis (TBM) is a rare condition in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). The aim of this study is to describe the clinical characteristics, possible risk factors, and outcomes of SLE patients with TBM.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: rgb(51, 51, 51);\"\u003EOn systematically reviewing medical records from10 SLE patients with TBM admitted to a hospital from December 2008 to December 2018. A total of 100 cases in the same period were randomly selected as controls from SLE inpatients without infection. In patients with TBM, the mean age at presentation was 35.2\u0026nbsp;years (range 19.8–45.2); the mean duration of SLE was 34.6\u0026nbsp;months (range 4–84\u0026nbsp;months).\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: rgb(51, 51, 51);\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;Patients with TBM had significantly longer SLE duration, higher ESR and CRP level, and lower CD4+ cell counts and albumin level than those without infections (\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003Ep\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: rgb(51, 51, 51);\"\u003E \u0026lt; 0.05 for all). There were no differences in prednisone dose at the time of symptom onset or cumulative dose over the preceding year between the two groups. Logistic regression analysis showed that patients with a lower CD4+ cell count were more likely to have TBM compared with controls (OR = 3.67,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Ci\u003Ep\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: rgb(51, 51, 51);\"\u003E = 0.020)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: rgb(51, 51, 51);\"\u003E.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003ETBM should be considered when SLE patients have central nervous system (CNS) symptoms with a longer duration, higher ESR and CRP level, and lower CD4+ cell counts and albumin level, even if the patients are receiving a low prednisone dose,and the patient being studied has a chronic headache and fits into this criteria\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: normal; text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003Ec) What is the efficacy of each of the drugs listed in her prior treatment plan that she was following since last two years before she stopped it two weeks back?\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E. Hydroxychloroquine\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E.sulfasalazine\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E. methylprednisolone\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E.aceclofenac\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv readability=\"41.880826915281716\" style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: normal; text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E. cholecalciferol\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E.alandronic acid\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E. flupirtine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E. gabapentin\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E. methylcobalamine tablets.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E1.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EWhy was she given bisphosphonates?\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E1)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003EHydroxychloroquine in SLE\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E“\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003EChloroquine, together with its hydroxyl derivative hydroxychloroquine, was initially used as an antimalarial agent, but is also useful in the treatment of autoimmune diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E• Chloroquine and hydroxychloroquine are approved for the treatment of SLE and have been shown to reduce the frequency of disease flares (particularly of lupus nephritis),\u0026nbsp;contribute to the maintenance of remission, prolong the onset of disease and reduce the risk of complications.Beyond their immunomodulatory effects in SLE, these agents have also been shown to protect against thrombotic events,\u0026nbsp;improve glucose and lipid profiles, and prevent renal damage,apparently resulting in reduced cardiovascular risk, for which SLE is an independent risk factor”\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003ESource:\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC7097534\/\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC7097534\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E2)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003Esulfasalazine\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003EImmunosuppressive drug used in the treatment of cutaneous manifestations of lupus.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003E“Sulfasalazine\u0026nbsp;is an effective agent for\u0026nbsp;chronic discoid lupus erythematosus\u0026nbsp;(CDLE) but the response to treatment is considerably variable between patients and is also unpredictable. The reason for this might relate to differences in metabolism of the drug which is extensively acetylated by the polymorphic enzyme N-acetyltransferase 2 (NAT2). To test this possibility, the N-acetylation phenotype of eleven patients with CDLE and treated by standard doses of\u0026nbsp;sulfasalazine\u0026nbsp;was retrospectively determined by genotyping. A clear-cut difference in the outcome of treatment was observed according to whether the patients were slow acetylators (SA) or rapid acetylators (RA). Eight out of 11 patients responded to treatment with a complete or marked remission of the disease. Seven of them were RA. The three other patients who did not respond at all to the drug were SA. In addition, SA seem to be more prone to toxic events. These findings strongly suggest that the genetic polymorphism of\u0026nbsp;NAT2\u0026nbsp;is responsible for differences in the response to\u0026nbsp;sulfasalazine\u0026nbsp;in patients with CDLE. Therefore, candidates for\u0026nbsp;sulfasalazine\u0026nbsp;therapy should be genotyped to identify those patients who might benefit from the drug.”\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 16px;\"\u003ESource:\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/journals.lww.com\/jpharmacogenetics\/Abstract\/1997\/04000\/NAT2_genotyping_and_efficacy_of_sulfasalazine_in.6.aspx\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/journals.lww.com\/jpharmacogenetics\/Abstract\/1997\/04000\/NAT2_genotyping_and_efficacy_of_sulfasalazine_in.6.aspx\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv readability=\"32.95503597122302\" style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: normal; text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117);\"\u003E\u003Cdiv readability=\"10\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E3) Please critically appraise the full text article linked below:\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Ca data-saferedirecturl=\"https:\/\/www.google.com\/url?hl=en\u0026amp;q=https:\/\/onlinelibrary.wiley.com\/doi\/full\/10.1111\/j.1365-2796.2003.01233.x\u0026amp;source=gmail\u0026amp;ust=1610125321028000\u0026amp;usg=AFQjCNHXD3ybzJ24LAs7F9GDZ3oIliRmEw\" href=\"https:\/\/onlinelibrary.wiley.com\/doi\/full\/10.1111\/j.1365-2796.2003.01233.x\" target=\"_blank\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/onlinelibrary.wiley.\u003Cwbr\u003Ecom\/doi\/full\/10.1111\/j.1365-\u003Cwbr\u003E2796.2003.01233.x\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003EWhat is the efficacy of aspirin in stroke in your assessment of the evidence provided in the article. letter-spacing: normal;\"\u003EHere is a case i have seen:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E55 year old male patient came with complaints of fever since 10 days, pain abdomen and vomitings since today morning. patient was apparently alright 10 days back then he had complaints of high grade fever, continuous associated with chills and rigors relieved with medication ,no diurnal variation. got admitted for 4 days in private hospital and got discharged. From today morning patient is complaining of pain in the epigastrium and right iliac fossa, associated with vomitings vomitings 2episodes of billious vomitings\u0026nbsp; and 10 to 15 episodes with water consistency and non projective\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehistory of similarity episodes 1 year back\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;patient is chronic alcoholic till one year back stopped after the similar episode he is a known case of diabetes since 8 years on glimi M1,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite: normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowels: regular\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBladder- normal micturition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFamily history:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of DM, HTN CAD, CVA, aasthma\u0026nbsp; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttp:\/\/ushaindurthi.blogspot.com\/2020\/11\/55-year-old-male-with-complaints-of.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. What is the problem representation of this patient and what could be the anatomical site of lesion ?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 55 year old male construction worker with Type 2 Diabetes mellitus who is a chronic alcoholic \u0026amp; smoker came with c\/o weakness of right upper limb with involuntary movements of both right UL \u0026amp; LL\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe anatomical site of lesion may be internal capsule(left sided) as it is the most common site for lacunar infarcts,also presents as hemiparesis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. Why are subcortical internal capsular infarcts more common that cortical infarcts?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Esubcortical infarcts are caused by occlusion of a penetrating artery from a large cerebral artery, most commonly from the Circle of Willis. These penetrating arteries arise at sharp angles from major vessels and are thus, anatomically prone to constriction and occlusion. So subcortical infarcts are more common than cortical infarcts.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. What is the pathogenesis involved in cerebral infarct related seizures?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n \u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEihGlrWicek4eMFHH-Bq6KHqZ1bl__K9M8jynuwrZ818eOlWIHZP_QS0Sq1jo1jyXzj0aBiuId-NWIC9fp9C5RMv1L6QYoOLLZdwm9liS2YTl_1bvySluo0A7KmUc9TsxUh4sG4JaCwrqQ\/s1600\/1608528568401046-0.png\" imageanchor=\"1\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\n \u003Cimg border=\"0\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEihGlrWicek4eMFHH-Bq6KHqZ1bl__K9M8jynuwrZ818eOlWIHZP_QS0Sq1jo1jyXzj0aBiuId-NWIC9fp9C5RMv1L6QYoOLLZdwm9liS2YTl_1bvySluo0A7KmUc9TsxUh4sG4JaCwrqQ\/s1600\/1608528568401046-0.png\" width=\"400\"\u003E\n \u003C\/a\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4. What is your take on the ecg? And do you agree with the treating team on starting the patient on Enoxaparin?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELeft axis deviation +\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EST depressions noted in precordial leads V1 to V6\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eso NSTEMI\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYes , i agree with the treating team on starting the patient on Enoxaparin.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.sciencedirect.com\/science\/article\/pii\/S0735109702029017\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.sciencedirect.com\/science\/article\/pii\/S0735109702029017\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5. Is it necessary to have a separate haemodialysis set up for hepatits B patients and why?\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EYes , separate machines must be used for patients known to be infected with HBV (or at high risk of new HBV infection). A machine that has been used for patients infected with HBV can be used again for non-infected patients only after it has been decontaminated\u0026nbsp; HBV because of increased risk of transmission due to contamination\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5. What are the efficacies of each treatment given to this patient? Describe the efficacies with supportive RCT evidence.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELactulose : for prevention and treatment of hepatic encephalopathy.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETenofovir : for HBV\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOctreotide : for upper GI bleed.\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC1750992\/#:~:text=In%20a%20meta-analysis%2C%20somatostatin,(mostly%20caused%20by%20gastritis)\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC1750992\/#:~:text=In%20a%20meta-analysis%2C%20somatostatin,(mostly%20caused%20by%20gastritis)\u003C\/a\u003E.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELasix : for fluid overload (AKI on CKD)\u0026nbsp;\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/books\/NBK499921\/#:~:text=The%20Food%20and%20Drug%20Administration,failure%20including%20the%20nephrotic%20syndrome.\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/books\/NBK499921\/#:~:text=The%20Food%20and%20Drug%20Administration,failure%20including%20the%20nephrotic%20syndrome.\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVitamin -k : for ? Specialized pro-resolving mediators and strategies aimed at boosting resolution such as using omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid exert differential effects on these targets and provide anti-inflammatory and pro-cognitive effects in neuroinflammation\/degeneration\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h1\u003E\u003Ch1 class=\"nova-e-text nova-e-text--size-m nova-e-text--family-sans-serif nova-e-text--spacing-none nova-e-text--color-inherit\" itemprop=\"caption\" style=\"margin: 0px; color: rgb(17, 17, 17); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: small;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h1\u003E\u003Ch1 class=\"nova-e-text nova-e-text--size-m nova-e-text--family-sans-serif nova-e-text--spacing-none nova-e-text--color-inherit\" itemprop=\"caption\" style=\"margin: 0px; color: rgb(17, 17, 17); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.3;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: georgia; font-size: small;\"\u003E(5) The accumulation of Aβ may lead to the microglial accumulation and activation resulting in increases in pro-inflammatory cytokines such as interleukin-1 beta, interleukin-6, and tumor necrosis factor-alpha. font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EA paradoxical clinical worsening of a known condition or the appearance of a new condition after initiating anti retroviral therapy (ART) therapy in HIV-infected patients resulting from restored immunity to specific infectious or non-infectious antigens is defined as immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS).\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: Roboto, sans-serif;\"\u003EAs his CD4 count is \u0026gt; 50 \/mm3 consider delayed initiation of ART ideally after 8 weeks of starting ATT to reduce the chances of developing IRIS\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117);
